description: Pinned synthetic smoke corpus for Entity Analyzer v18.1. This is a pipeline anchor, independent of the real corpus: it pins the observable entities_table.csv output for a small set of documented edge cases.
hash_normalization: CRLF and CR are normalized to LF before SHA-256; this keeps the anchor identical on Windows and Linux without changing the published CLI.

merkle.algorithm: Leaves are SHA-256(UTF-8(relative_path) + 0x00 + lowercase_file_sha256_hex). Paths use '/' separators and are sorted by their UTF-8 bytes. A parent is SHA-256(left_digest_bytes + right_digest_bytes); an odd last node is promoted unchanged. The root is uppercase hex.
merkle.path_normalization: relative to corpus_root; forward slashes; no case folding; sorted by UTF-8 bytes

deduplication.policy: Skip exact content duplicates detected by SHA-256 of file bytes. One path is retained per hash; the retained path is the first path discovered by the engine, and the remaining paths are reported as skipped duplicates.
deduplication.scope: Only supported files are considered; unsupported files are scanned but not analyzed.
deduplication.smoke_note: The smoke-corpus duplicate pair is intentionally mention-free so the pinned entities_table.csv hash does not depend on which duplicate path is canonical. The anchor check still asserts one duplicate group and one skipped file.
